mg.title: Homework and Hoops tag
mg.src: Michelle Young, 030_3166.MXF [00:41] “a program called Homework and Hoops”
mg.use: On “Homework and Hoops”, after the hook text is off. One text at a time.

mg.title: A chance to play

text.main: give the students a chance to play basketball

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway on the end of her line. It can hide the jump cut instead of the punch-in.

mg.title: Such a small thing

text.main: such a small thing that a lot of times people take for granted

mg.use: Over Michelle as she says it. Big and readable. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Start to light up

text.main: you can see them start to light up

mg.use: At the end of the row, as she says it. Keep captions on.

mg.title: The moment

text.main: The moment that has stuck with me today is watching the students come in.

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway at the start of the row, as she says it. Then back to her face.

mg.title: New sneakers on

text.main: by the end they're running around with their new sneakers on

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway to break the long bite, as she says it. Keep her audio under.

mg.title: So confident

text.main: they're just so confident and they're so happy

mg.use: Over Michelle after the punch-in, back at 100%, as she says it.

mg.title: Confidence grows

text.main: see the confidence grow in front of your face

mg.use: Top band over her face as she says it. Clear it before “really joyful” so her smile is clean.
